sentences.text: For the SIBAL fabric material, microgravity (0 g) tests recorded flame spread rates of 1 mm/s across various oxygen concentrations, flows, and pressures.
However, none of the available records were conducted under the assumed scenario inputs of 0.165 g lunar gravity, 34 mol% O2, or 56.5 kPa pressure.

limit: The dataset contains microgravity (0 g) and normal Earth gravity tests, but no tests conducted in 0.165 g lunar gravity. Earth (1 g) and orbit (~0 g) results do not bound lunar or Martian behavior; flammability in partial gravity like lunar gravity may be higher than in 0 g.

next.target: Flames spread testing of SIBAL fabric in partial gravity (0.165 g) under 34 mol% O2 and 56.5 kPa pressure.

scope: In our curated dataset; illustrative, not an approved NASA plan.
missingFields: solid fuel burning data at 0.165 g
